batch: September 4, 2026 - carrier and PFAS-soil disposal context reconciliation
methods: Recovered the supplied carrier folder one directory deeper under OneDrive after the stale Codex-session paths failed.
Calculated SHA-256 and byte size for all five supplied files, inspected the three PNGs and treated them only as views derived from the two complete parent PDFs.

Reviewed embedded text across all 1,051 PDF pages. The EPA archive cover and the Oscoda bill of lading had no embedded text and were reviewed visually; the short section-divider pages and both cited source pages were also rendered and checked.

Searched the complete PDFs for Northern A-1, American Waste, Wexford County Landfill, the EPA ID, bill-of-lading number, PFAS waste, shipment quantities, dates, truck and trailer identifiers and disposal wording.
Evaluated the evidence against the open 2009-July 2019 Wexford-leachate receiving-history requirements without converting later PFAS-soil transport into earlier Cadillac leachate evidence.

contentFindings.finding: EPA's 2014 PCB handler report lists Northern A-1 Services, EPA ID MID020906814, as a transporter and names American Waste as the owner facility.
contentFindings.boundary: The registry entry is not a shipment record, does not identify PFAS handling and does not establish the carrier for Wexford-to-Cadillac leachate deliveries.

contentFindings.finding: The report says Northern A-1 transported three drums of investigation-derived PFAS soil from the Oscoda site to Wexford County Landfill. Bill of lading 05032-22 records the three drums, quantity 1,500 with UOM 'P,' transporter, truck, trailer, approval number and dates.
contentFindings.boundary: The bill's disposal-facility field names Northern A-1 Services rather than Wexford County Landfill. The 2022 Oscoda soil movement is outside the requested period and is neither landfill leachate nor a Cadillac WWTP receipt.

contentFindings.finding: The supplied contact sheet corresponds to laboratory QC results, chronicles, receipt forms and isotope-dilution summaries already contained in the complete report.
contentFindings.boundary: Those pages are analytical-support material for the Oscoda investigation and do not create separate records or Cadillac-specific results.

queueDecision: No receiving-history requirement is closed. The batch documents a separate 2022 PFAS-soil movement and carrier/ownership context, but supplies none of the requested 2009-July 2019 Wexford leachate manifests, Cadillac receiving logs, delivery-linked invoices or ledger entries, executed 2009 agreement and rate schedule, signed renewals or amendments, or dated final leachate delivery record.
evidentiaryBoundary: The records support a later Northern A-1/American Waste carrier relationship and a separate Wexford-destination statement in an Oscoda PFAS report. They must not be used to infer the identity of a 2009-2019 Cadillac leachate hauler, prove a Wexford-to-Cadillac load or resolve the final-delivery date.
